<!--
PR Title Template::  type(scope): description

Example: feat(extractor):  Implement a new data extraction module to add support for Postgres databases.

Commit Types:
fix: Bug fix for the user, not a fix to a build script
feat: New feature for the user, not a new feature for build script
refactor: Refactoring production code such as renaming a variable
revert: Reverts a previous commit
chore: Updating grunt tasks, etc; no production code change
test: Adding missing tests, refactoring tests; no production code change
perf: Code changes that improve performance
ci: Changes to configuration files and scripts
exp: New experiments (POC) with different models and approaches
style: Formatting, missing semicolons, no production code change
docs: Changes to the documentation

Scope Examples:
extractor
preprocessor
feature engineering
model/approach name
dash/visualization
Data Preparation
-->
[General guide](https://riotintopace.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PAM/pages/4182966273/PR+Review+Guideline) for efficient pull request review.
